resources.string:
**Features**
 **•** Support for Multiple Cafes
 **•** Time Off in day preview 
 **•** Nicknames for co-workers and cafes
 **•** Toggle cafes and notifications for cafes.
 **•** Option to *Post*, *Trade*, and *Cover* shifts rather than just posting them.
 **•** Authentication Options
 **•** Combine Shifts in Detail View (toggle-able)
 
 **Fixes**
 **•** Schedule Page
 **•** Swapping between pages swaps then loads data
Shows coworkers currently scheduled at the cafe.
Shows your next upcoming shift and scheduled coworkers.
